A '''Force drain''' makes the opponent lose Force at a location the player controls. During the control phase, at each location the player controls, they may Force drain an amount equal to the opponent's Force icons there.<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref> Each Force drain is announced and completed one at a time.<ref name="rb20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0]]</ref>

The opponent chooses whether to lose the cards from hand, [[Life Force]] or both, and places them face up on the Lost Pile. Cards can add a bonus (for example "Force drain +1 here") or other modifiers.<ref name="rb20" /><ref name="gl20" /> An opponent who can [[react]] to the location and bring presence there cancels the Force drain.<ref name="gl20" />

Force icons cut both ways: more icons on a player's side of a location let them activate more Force, but also let the opponent drain more there if they gain control.<ref name="rb20" />
